ASBU was established in 2013 in Ankara-Ulus
district. ASBU is the first and only state university
in the field of social sciences in Türkiye.
ASBU is a State University that:
Focuses on research-oriented education
Values international cooperation
 Prioritizes research on contemporary issues
 Has a global area of   interest
 Maintains a rich library that offers
multilingual and multicultural perspectives
Integrates national and spiritual values into
society, positively impacting the community
Contributes to the transformation of its
surroundings

Medical Services
Our health center provides primary medical care,
first aid, and consultations with healthcare
professionals during working hours. The
university’s medical center operates on a by
appointment basis. Appointments can be
scheduled through the online system;
https://sksdb.asbu.edu.tr/tr/saglik-hizmetleri-1

SCHOOL FACILITIES
Accomodation
Our university does not provide accommodation
services, and we are unable to assist with housing
arrangements. However, students can find various
dormitory and rental options in Ankara on their
own.
Student Societies
Our student clubs cover a wide range of interests,
including literature, technology, music,
international relations, and more. Whatever your
passion, there is a place for you!
https://topluluk.asbu.edu.tr/
Campus Details
A comprehensive map of our campus is available
on the next page for your convenience.

The student societies operating in our university aim to ensure that
all our students spend their time outside of education productively
by organizing professional, scientific, social, artistic, cultural and
sports activities. Our aim is not only to enable students to gain
academic competence, but also to develop team spirit and
representation skills in a social sense and to enable them to prepare
for life with self-confidence. Societies are a meeting place for
students in line with their common interests. They are the starting
point for new friendships with creative projects.

EXPERIENCESEXPERIENCES

The Self-Access Center (SAC) at the
School of Foreign Languages provides a
vibrant and stress-free environment
where students can practice English
through various materials and activities,
with or without the guidance of a teacher.
The SAC creates an immersive experience
primarily in English, while also
incorporating Arabic in different ways.
The main goal of the SAC is to enhance
English language learning beyond the
traditional classroom setting.
SAC at ASBU helps students develop both independent learning skills
(learner autonomy) and language ability in four skills (reading, writing,
listening, and speaking). In order to ensure students acquire
independent learning skills, SAC offers regular workshops on self-study
skills and shares information about useful websites and online
applications.
SACSAC

ASBU School of Foreign Languages   was deemed worthy of the "Orange Flag" award
within the scope of the Barrier-Free University 2024 awards given by the Council of
Higher Education in order to raise awareness and disseminate good practices
regarding the access of disabled individuals to venues, educational opportunities
and socio-cultural activities at universities.
